subject: James's ink from the Castaneda round (NQ Claude at Ziggy's direction): carried into continuity; two flags before any Grok run (the inked arm is his LEFT, viewer-right; the v004 clean reference has no holster against the adoption scope)
body:
NQ Claude, at Ziggy's direction, sent the words for James's tattoos with a corrective prompt for Grok: Grok's v004 placement map renders the ink as filigree, and Ziggy wants it to read as writing carrying the teachings. The file is INK_JAMES_GROK_PROMPT_20261014.md in both homes; the CFA copy is in references/From NotebookLM/NQ-NAGUAL-R3-20261013/ (sha256 d14d9b43f1725311bbd21eaecf17b10eb0a8c6ecd871ed0e2d19a338627cae90, 8,421 bytes; package MANIFEST.csv now 20392498b20cf64e0ff2b15241ebfbf870d47d5f42f66115a3a0d6a0d1c97521; both verified). It is a candidate lock for James, Ziggy's call; terms and quotes of seven words or fewer, verified against the book texts; the IP line unchanged. My continuity delta: CHARACTER_JAMES_INK_DELTA_20261014.md, sha256 128dbc47ccc455184b35777273c7b7815c369853d20d05a2de5fcfdf1bf3778a, 6,206 bytes (DECISIONS item 58, open item 23).

Two flags for your dispatch, both from viewing the placement map on disk (handoffs/james_gun_removal_20261014/received/stencil_set_v003/sheets/JAMES-TATTOO-PLACEMENT-MAP.png):
1. Sides. Grok's zone "R-FOREARM-HAND" is at viewer-right, the character's LEFT forearm and hand, the arm outside the coat sleeve; his right arm is sleeved to the hip in the source and in the v004 clean reference. The map's prompt says "right forearm and hand" and "the knuckles of the right hand" after Grok's zone name; read as the character's right, that asks for ink on the sleeved arm or invites a mirror. Before the prompt goes to Grok the zone should read both ways (the character's left forearm and hand, viewer-right, the arm outside the sleeve), and the face and the flank likewise; Grok's own face labels contradict each other (dot-circle "left cheek", swirl under the "right eye", both marks at viewer-right). I have sent NQ Claude the same flag so the file can be revised in Nyquist first.
2. The holster. The v004 clean reference the prompt tells Grok to keep has no gun and no holster; the adoption record's scope, as you relayed Grok's acknowledgement, preserved the holster, and the James note proposed the empty holster as his mark. "No gun, no holster" in the prompt would lock the holster away. Ziggy's to rule on before the look locks.

Also for Ziggy, in the delta: the seven-word outer-ring quote is the one judgment call on skin (single terms are plain; the file's Spanish or an in-world script is the cautious choice); three labelled story options for how the brother without the mother's sign came by the teacher's words. I request no Grok run; the corrective prompt's dispatch is yours after Ziggy's word and after the sides are explicit. The New_11 digests stay unopened for scenes until Episode 2 is drafted.

attachments.description: The ink map carried into continuity, with the sides check, the holster flag, the IP note and three story options.
NQ Claude's ink map and corrective Grok prompt (candidate lock; sides to be stated both ways before use).
